agents.role: Enumerate the repositories available to the connected GitHub identity and preserve affiliation/visibility boundaries.
agents.privacy: Private and unknown-visibility repositories are excluded from public artifacts.

agents.role: Collect README and relevant documentation path metadata from a rotating batch of public projects.
agents.privacy: Does not copy non-public repository content.

agents.role: Register only actual ChatGPT export records made available to the repository intake.
agents.privacy: No automatic access to unseen ChatGPT conversations; no raw transcript publication.

agents.role: Extract literal logical units only from content the connected runtime can actually read.
inputs: logic wiki articles and approved export records
agents.privacy: Candidate only; source content must not be paraphrased as verified truth.

agents.role: Check references, stable IDs, typing, and explicit semantic scope.
Compose nested logic candidates while retaining parent lineage and invariants.
Generate/inspect counter-readings, contradictions, negative and boundary tests.
Run unit/invariant tests and track semantic test-suite deficits separately.
agents.privacy: Unit-test pass does not equal semantic validity.

agents.role: Build versioned Logic Wiki pages and cross-links from approved source-backed catalog items.
agents.privacy: Raw private transcripts are never public wiki inputs.

agents.role: Verify the Wix deployment and record read-back status; do not assume the GitHub runner has Wix credentials.
agents.privacy: If write/read-back is unavailable, mark BLOCKED.

agents.role: Publish scan reports as workflow artifacts and surface access gaps.
agents.privacy: No automatic merge, no Wix write, no private-project names in public artifacts.

cross_project_write_policy: Read broadly where authorized; write to a project only through a review branch/PR and only for changes belonging to that project. Otherwise record an integration proposal in WANGA-LAB.
conversation_access_policy: Connected GitHub and Files/Library are not a universal ChatGPT conversation API. Missing conversations remain ACCESS_GAP until an actual export or surfaced file is available.
